final: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), total_volume_calc AS (SELECT SUM(volume) as total_volume FROM product_volumes), shares AS (SELECT pv.product_id, pv.volume, pv.volume / tvc.total_volume as share FROM product_volumes pv, total_volume_calc tvc), avg_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.volume, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share_value WHERE s.share > avg_share_value.avg_share) SELECT SUM(volume) as combined_volume, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) as avg_distance_above FROM above_avg
